habitat: Broadleaf; mixed; and coniferous forests from low to middle elevations
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Long Tailed Minivet (Pericrocotus ethologus) stands out. This species, part of the Campephagidae family, is a resident of Broadleaf; mixed; and coniferous forests from low to middle elevations. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Long Tailed Minivet is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Long Tailed Minivet and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
